1.

Abba, Father, we Thee call, Precious names, it is our right. None but the child cries Abba thus in childlike manner. Through Jesus Christ we possess This privilege, gift free; And Thy Spirit in us witnesses That we are now God’s children.

2.

Though the fall seemed to separate Us from Thee for everlasting time, Christ has now brought us to Thee, He on the cross established peace. Through Him we have salvation, Thou hast shown us Thy grace. O, what height and depth of love, We with Christ are one!

3.

Thou, O Father, didst think of us, On Thy heart Thou didst bear us, When in Christ Thou didst choose us, Before the world was created. Thou didst make known to us Thy good pleasure, The secret of Thy counsel. Father, we Thy love praise, The riches of Thy grace.
